parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more granular personalization (referencing specific dollar figures tied to the user's expenses, loss comfort, and horizon) and keeps all recommendations at low risk aligned with the conservative profile, whereas System B introduces a moderate-risk international position that is less aligned with a loss-comfort-2 retiree. System B has slightly more concrete actionable tickers (SCHD, SGOV, VYMI) but the risk-alignment and personalization advantages of A outweigh this.
